title: Takeoff Monkey bot tool manifest
description: Schema every tools/<name>/tool.json must satisfy. tool_registry.py validates against this at startup and skips (does not crash on) a manifest that fails.

name.description: Must equal the tool's directory name.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema handed to Anthropic as the tool's input_schema. Must declare an object with an 'input_file' (or files) reference where a file is required.

confirm.description: Set true if running this tool makes a change the user would want a say in (deletes, overwrites, posts somewhere, spends money). The bot then refuses to run it until the model has asked via ask_user and passes user_confirmed=true. Defaults to false — the read-only analysis tools don't need it.

triggers.description: Optional deterministic routing on top of the model's judgement. keywords: case-insensitive regexes; one appearing in the user's message adds a routing note naming this tool, and — together with an action_words match, or on its own if action_words is absent — makes the turn an action. action_words: case-insensitive regexes for the verbs/nouns that make a keyword hit an actual request (format, clean up, worksheet…), so questions merely mentioning the keyword are left to the selector. filename_contains: case-insensitive substrings of an attachment's filename that add a routing note pointing the model at this tool. Notes respect accepts.file_types: with no acceptable file attached they tell the model to ask for one with ask_user instead of starting.
